narrative.text: Merchant MID100109 declared home_furnishing at onboarding 891 days ago. Telemetry dissents: the largest deviations from the home_furnishing baseline are round_share_drift at +10.9 sigma (observed 0.221 against a category baseline of 0.00022), slope_log_volume at +4.6 sigma (observed 0.0122 against a category baseline of 0.00176), chargeback_rate at +3.8 sigma (observed 0.0083 against a category baseline of 0.0021). The homepage surface presents a sports_betting interface at 0.87 confidence, against a declared category of home_furnishing. This vertical cannot be approved on this platform. It is linked to 6 other merchant accounts by rare shared phone fp, though they are not moving in step. A verification call was placed and produced no usable statement, which counts neither for nor against the merchant. In total 3 independent views of this merchant contradict its declaration. The investigation used 2 of a permitted 8 steps and stopped because confidence threshold met. Recommended tier restricts settlements, corroborated by the telemetry channel; the storefront alone would not have been sufficient.
